name: badjilounes
description: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace by @codboard — CodBoard, an AgentOps task-tracking plugin for audited AI-assisted development workflows, Sofia, a multi-channel AI social-publishing plugin, and Acceptance, Gherkin acceptance criteria and proofs kept in your YouTrack or Azure DevOps tickets.

plugins.name: codboard
plugins.description:
Give Claude Code an audited task board for the tickets it handles.

CodBoard turns external tickets into trackable requests, breaks them down into actionable tasks, keeps status, branches, pull requests and daily reports in sync, and watches open PRs for new comments or required follow-ups.

It bundles the CodBoard MCP server and watcher workflow as on-demand Claude Code skills.

Developed by @CodBoard.

plugins.name: sofia
plugins.description:
Drive Sofia — the multi-channel AI social-publishing platform — from Claude Code.

Connects by consent: one URL, no key to paste, no password in a config file. Read your establishment's profile and statistics, reuse or upload media, write and publish posts across Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and Facebook, and propose a campaign plan Sofia will judge before holding it.

Permissions are asked one at a time — reading first, publishing only when you ask for it — and revoked from Sofia in one click.

Developed by @badjilounes.

plugins.name: acceptance
plugins.description:
Acceptance criteria first, proofs last, and the ticket in between.

Claude negotiates Gherkin acceptance criteria with you before writing code, creates the ticket in your tracker — YouTrack or Azure DevOps — with the full context and names the branch after it, then collects every proof (captures, videos, cURL, test runs, artifacts) into that ticket.

Rules, proofs and the ticket are published as three artifacts per ticket, linked from a band above the prompt; any later session recovers them from the branch name.

Developed by @badjilounes.
